citations.narrative:
One wooden post on the perimeter fence moved when touched by inspectors and one wooden perpendicular board to
that post had become unattached due to deterioration. Failure to maintain facilities such as the perimeter fence may lead
to escape or entrapment of regulated animals. Correct by ensuring all facilities are structurally sound and maintained in
good repair to protect the animals from injury and contain the animals securely.
To be corrected by: 29-June-2026

A freezer used for food storage contained a deceased animal not for consumption. There was an accumulation of frozen
blood and meat by-products on the bottom and sides of the freezer. Failure to maintain a clean freezer space may lead to
deterioration of food sources and contamination of food from deceased animals not meant for consumption. Ensure
supplies of food and bedding are stored in facilities which adequately protect such supplies against deterioration, molding,
or contamination by vermin.
To be corrected by: 3-July-2026

The water bowls in the 2 enclosures, one enclosure containing 2 foxes and one enclosure containing 1 raccoon, have
green algae present in them and is the only water receptacle present for each enclosure. Buildup of algae and organic
material in water does not provide the animals potable water and may lead to health problems and disease hazards.
Potable water must be provided as often as necessary for the health and comfort of the animals. All water receptacles
shall be kept clean and sanitary. The facility must provide potable water and ensure the water receptacle is kept clean
and sanitary.
To be corrected by: 29-June-2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
Additional Inspectors:
Paige Johnson, ANIMAL CARE INSPECTOR n
